assessmentVersionRecords fingerprints actual DE/EN/FA counterpart content with the same canonical identity; selected version hashing and legacy baseline decisions are otherwise unchanged.

Existing canonical helper preserves de inside de-quervain when normalizing actual en/fa question IDs. Current-bank uniqueness and every real counterpart explicitly tested; no assertion of universal parsing for future arbitrary ID grammars.
